title: 08. Geo-Economic Priority & Action Zoning
subtitle: Multivariate agro-economic decision zoning & climate-resilience prioritization
key_finding: 9,899.7 ha (₹109.0 Cr indicative value at risk) of cropland falls in RESILIENCE (375.1 ha flooded in Dec 2023 · 7,156.3 ha low-lying (HAND) · 3,187.5 ha low water security). 5,203.8 ha (12.4%) is classified as high-value PROTECT farmland.

categories.name: RESILIENCE
categories.action: Drainage and flood bunds; PMFBY crop insurance enrolment; flood-tolerant varieties; early warning.

categories.name: PROTECT
categories.action: Maintain canal and tank supply; prevent conversion to non-farm use; prioritise for market linkage.

categories.name: OPTIMIZE
categories.action: Water-efficient practices (AWD / SRI for paddy, drip for banana); scheduling based on the Transplanting Calendar.

categories.name: INVEST
categories.action: Recharge structures (see Groundwater module sites); irrigation extension; road connectivity; storage.

categories.name: Stable / monitor
categories.action: No priority intervention; continue routine monitoring.

method: Multi-indicator parcel evaluation across 6 normalized dimensions: Productivity (P), Indicative Gross Crop Value (V), Water Security (W: canal proximity + GWPI + multi-year stability), Flood Exposure (F: Sentinel-1 Dec 2023 SAR change mapping + HAND), Market Access (M: OSM road MCP travel time), and Infrastructure (I). Decision taxonomy applied via strict rule hierarchy. INVEST rule requires at least 2 of 3 constraints (P < 40th, M <= 40th, I <= 40th) and hydrogeological potential. Intervention clusters partitioned on a 1 km grid and filtered to 5–150 ha.
limitations: The December 2023 flood footprint is based on Sentinel-1 pre-event (2023-11-06, 2023-11-11, 2023-11-18, 2023-11-23) and post-event acquisitions (2023-12-17 onset, 2023-12-29). The 29 Dec scene is 11–12 days after peak rainfall (17–18 Dec 2023, ~950 mm in 24h), capturing the minimum observed extent due to rapid alluvial drainage. Crop value figures are indicative estimates based on published MSP and regional agronomic benchmarks. Market travel time relies on OpenStreetMap road network completeness and nominal speed profiles.
